name: Boulton and Watt Lap engine speed governor
description: A centrifugal governor adjusted steam admission as engine speed changed, regulating a rotary engine driving workshop machinery.

impact.note: One governor borrowed from mills, but steam-engine speed regulation and the later theory of governors descend from this adoption; used by engineers.

date.label: Around 1788
date.basis: The date applies to this documented case, not to the worldwide origin of the capability.

events.statement: The museum dates the Lap engine to 1788 and describes its centrifugal governor, sun-and-planet gearing and use driving polishing machines.

evidence.supports: The museum dates the Lap engine to 1788 and describes its centrifugal governor, sun-and-planet gearing and use driving polishing machines.
The Smithsonian reports a millwright mechanism as background and describes the Lap governor operating shortly after late-1788 references.
The museum dates the Lap engine to 1788 and describes its centrifugal governor, sun-and-planet gearing and use driving polishing machines.

earliest_record.rationale: Earliest researched operational or depicted case for this record, not a claim of global priority.

caveats: The Smithsonian account places first governor operation shortly after late-1788 references; the exact installation date is not given. Earlier mill mechanisms informed the design.

research.note: Independent review checked the engine and sun-and-planet gearing; the first governor use is described as shortly after the late-1788 references, so the installation date remains approximate.

links.statement: The Lap engine incorporated sun-and-planet gearing of the type described in Watt’s earlier rotative-engine specification.
links.scope: The sun-and-planet mechanism in this particular engine; the speed governor was an additional mechanism.
links.caveats: The gear and the governor perform distinct functions; the relationship does not establish that the governor originated with the gear.

evidence.supports: The Science Museum identifies the Lap engine’s sun-and-planet geared arrangement.
